app.name: Gradebook
nav.label: Site
classes.title: Teaching groups
classes.lede: Choose a group to record scores, release tasks and add remarks.
markbook.title: Mark sheet
markbook.lede: Pick a score to alter it. The overall percentage, band and group means are recalculated when you store it.
msg.unreachable: The score was not stored. Check the network and try once more.
msg.mark_invalid: Scores are whole numbers between 0 and {max}; an empty box removes the score.
msg.stale: A task's maximum changed after this sheet was loaded. Reload the mark sheet before recording scores.
export.body: Copy the mark sheet table and paste it into a spreadsheet to take the scores elsewhere. Overall percentages and bands come across as values rather than formulas.
assess.publish_help: Released scores appear on each pupil's page. Scores in a hidden task are seen by staff only.
msg.max_same: The highest possible score is {max} already.
msg.max_invalid: The highest possible score must be a whole number between 1 and 1000.
msg.max_below: One pupil already scored {highest}; the highest possible score cannot go under {highest}.
msg.published: Released. Pupils can see these scores now.
msg.already_published: This task has been released already.
msg.withdrawn: Hidden. Pupils no longer see these scores.
msg.feedback_saved: Remark added. {name} will see it on their page.
msg.feedback_choose: Pick a remark from the list first.
msg.note_long: A note may hold at most 10,000 characters.
student.title: Your scores
student.provisional_help: Uses released scores only and may move as more tasks are scored.
report.title: Band summary
report.lede: Pupils per band, counting only pupils with every score recorded.
help.title: Guide
help.marks: Pick a score on the mark sheet, enter the new value and store it. Scores run from 0 to the task's highest possible score; clearing the box removes the score. A task's highest possible score is changed on the task page and may not drop below an existing score.
help.rounding: Tasks count towards the overall percentage by weight: Homework 20%, Quiz 20%, Project 30%, Exam 30%. The exact value is shown to one decimal place, rounding halves upwards, once every task has a score.
help.levels: Band 5 at 80% or more, band 4 at 70%, band 3 at 60%, band 2 at 50%, band 1 below that, taken from the displayed percentage.
help.publish: Pupils see a task's scores only after it is released, and no longer once it is hidden. The running percentage counts released scores only.
help.notes: Remarks picked from the list appear on the pupil's page. Staff-only notes stay with staff and never reach the pupil.
missing.title: Not found
missing.body: No page lives at this address.
